CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_sustainability_index(p_equipment_code character varying)
RETURNS TABLE(
    equipment_code character varying,
    equipment_type USER-DEFINED,
    equipment_model character varying,
    power_source USER-DEFINED,
    energy_efficiency_percent numeric,
    sustainability_index numeric
) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        e.equipmentcode,
        e.equipmenttype,
        e.equipmentmodel,
        pb.powersource,
        pb.energyefficiencypercent,
        ROUND(CAST(
            pb.energyefficiencypercent * CASE 
                WHEN pb.powersource IN ('Solar', 'Wind') THEN 1.5
                WHEN pb.powersource = 'Hybrid' THEN 1.2
                WHEN pb.powersource = 'Battery' THEN 1.0
                WHEN pb.powersource = 'Diesel' THEN 0.7
                ELSE 0
            END AS numeric), 4)
    FROM equipment e
    JOIN powerbattery pb ON pb.pwrbatteqref = e.equipmentcode
    WHERE e.equipmentcode = p_equipment_code;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
